name: Government ID / Passport Verification
objective: Validate document expiry dates, citizen status parameters, and legal full names.

attributes.name: Document Type
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify the document (Passport, National ID, Driver's License, Residence Permit).

attributes.name: Legal Full Name
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the legal full name as printed.

attributes.name: Date of Birth
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the holder's date of birth.

attributes.name: Place of Issue
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the place / authority of issue.

attributes.name: Citizen Status
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify residency/citizen status (Citizen, Permanent Resident, Work Permit, Other).
